notes.title: 🚀 Desktop Fidget - Official Release! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!


 We’re excited to share that Desktop Fidget is officially out now on Steam! 🎉



It’s a cozy little app where you can click, drag, spin, and toss around quirky virtual fidgets - a playful way to keep your hands busy and melt away stress during work or study breaks.

The full release includes 20+ fidgets and many hidden things for you to explore.

👉 Get Desktop Fidget on Steam: 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759380/Desktop_Fidget/"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks so much for supporting us and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 💙
